derivation:
by
  simp_rw [← Real.norm_eq_abs] at h ⊢
  simpa [nsmul_eq_mul] using norm_sum_le_of_le (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin L.length)) (n := fun _ => c) (fun i _ => h _ (L.get_mem i))
explanation: Specialize the finite-sum norm bound to the list's positions and the constant bound c. Simplification identifies the indexed sum with the mapped list sum and the constant sum with length times c.
